vulnerabilities.description: Temporary files created for GitHub CLI operations may not be cleaned up if the process crashes before the finally block executes, potentially exposing sensitive content
vulnerabilities.impact: Temporary files containing sensitive GitHub content could persist in /tmp directory
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement process-level signal handlers or use temp-file library with guaranteed cleanup

vulnerabilities.description: Memory data stored in JSON files without explicit file permission settings. Could be readable by other system users
vulnerabilities.impact: Sensitive project context could be exposed to other system users

vulnerabilities.description: Session files written without explicit permission settings
vulnerabilities.impact: Session context could be readable by other users on shared systems
vulnerabilities.remediation: Add fs.chmodSync(SESSION_FILE, 0o600) after writing session files

vulnerabilities.description: Statusline reads and displays project structure information that could reveal internals
vulnerabilities.impact: Project architectural details could be inferred from status output
vulnerabilities.remediation: Sanitize output to hide sensitive metrics

hardcoded_secrets.findings: No hardcoded API keys, passwords, credentials, or tokens found

sql_injection.findings: No database queries or SQL statements. Static site generation without backend

xss_vulnerabilities.findings: No innerHTML, dangerouslySetInnerHTML, eval(), or Function() calls

command_injection.findings: Uses spawnSync() safely without shell interpretation

dependency_vulnerabilities.findings: All dependencies from official npm with no known critical vulnerabilities

environment_variables.findings: NEXT_PUBLIC_ variables correctly used for public data only

authentication.findings: Static site with no authentication system

recommendations.action: Fix temporary file cleanup in github-safe.js
Set file permissions 0o600 on memory.js and session.js output
Enforce HTTPS and HSTS in production
Add npm audit to CI/CD pipeline
